policy: RESIDENTIAL DWELLING INSURANCE / Policy wording "WD-2026" - Accidental Damage and Optional Glazing Edition
description: Accidental damage claim on the home contents cover. A bowl was knocked off a shelf and fell, catching the display cabinet on the way down. The glass panel in the cabinet door cracked, and a solid-wood side table next to the cabinet was knocked and dented in the same fall. A glazier remade the cabinet pane to measure and refitted it, and cleared away the broken glass. A separate contractor repaired the dented side table. A couple of things on the billing to flag. The contractor also touched up some older scratches on a second cabinet that were already there before the incident, and the invoice carries a return visit as well as an administrative flat rate.

lines.3: Installation of the new glass into the frame 1 pcs
lines.5: Repair of dented solid-wood side table (knocked over in the same fall) | 1 flat rate
lines.6: Touch-up of pre-existing scratches on a second cabinet (present before the incident) | 1 flat rate
